title: Audit case-insensitive replay inputs against Git spelling
body:
On a case-insensitive macOS volume, a declared `SRC/DEP.json` input passes complete metadata validation while Git tracks `src/dep.json`; a commit changing only the tracked file then produces a successful empty replay matrix. This source-bound audit reproduces that gap on main and the exact PR2986 symlink-repair successor, answering [its native Git-spelling handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2983#discussioncomment-18977798).

The package adds six real Git/CLI fixtures, byte-identical authenticated runner snapshots, observed evidence, explicit replay and a repair handoff. Canonical declarations select the consumer against the same target-only diff; deleted-parent, unrelated-input, malformed-metadata/no-partial-output and six source-authentication controls pass. The additional VERIFY dependency is unpinned, as permitted by the schema; this does not show that wrongly spelled SOURCES input pins pass provenance checks.

Validation: registered Python 3.12.14 replay, optimized Python 3.14.7 native replay, optimized Git-free source-export replay, metadata/source pins, exact committed-byte check and diff checks pass locally. Case-sensitive hosts run portable controls and explicitly report native reproduction unavailable; `--require-native` fails there. Hosted CI and native Windows execution are unverified.

Scientific baseline: main `b3f3ee0392b71b118fd086a6eaf6b4cab54ef455`; submission rebased onto revision-6 main `836b19bfa309ceafbc8ee32a15e8c4b10dde7e11`, whose relevant runner and selected record are unchanged. PR2986 source: `f610bda7818df522c26b28f5766a06c5ef5c270c`. Final overlap completely paginated 234 open PRs, 2,440 closed PRs and 1,703 discussion records, with no warnings, within documented metadata/sparse-local limits.

Credit Nick Petalas/PR2986 for the handoff and symlink repair, EdDiboi's earlier symlink finding, woklerx/PR1891, Charles Bethin, Douglas Colkitt and retained workflow authors. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; author-checked, no independent human review claimed. The original picker draw and explicit portable-replay scope override are recorded in TASK.json.

No shared-runner adoption, supplier/exponent change or full cold replay is proposed. The next task is an exact Git-spelling contract that preserves deletion and case-only rename behavior, with index/export and normalization semantics defined.
